escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now the champions of every continent meet in one ranking. Superstars with hundreds of millions of subscribers against small channels with just a few thousand. One video game on every continent, and a trailer the whole world talked about. Only one video can be number one in the world. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Today we count down the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week on the planet. Stay until the very end, because the final answer might surprise you.

The world rules: the top three of every list from every continent compete here, with the same videos and the same numbers from this week's world tour. One video per creator on each list. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Ready? Let's go.

First list: the ten most viewed in the world. Opening the global countdown at number ten, from Egypt, Omar kotb. A nineteen-second Short with over eighteen point seven million views. Africa enters the world stage.
Number nine, from Turkey, Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Thirty-six seconds and over nineteen million views. Europe's champion of likes, now in the world ranking.
Number eight, from South Korea, RESCENE, with “2026 MAMA”. Just ten seconds, and over nineteen point eight million views.
Number seven, from India, Maddock Films, with a promo featuring Shraddha Kapoor, for a film in cinemas on December fourth. Over twenty-seven point two million views.
Number six, SEEDPIT Official, with “Kevin says Seed is TOO SMALL”. Europe's most viewed video, with over twenty-eight million views.

Number five, and this is the story of the week. Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, with “Our new pediatrician taught me this”. Eighteen seconds, over thirty-one million views, from a channel of about thirteen thousand subscribers. Number one in Africa, number five in the world.

Number four, from the United States, VerrTV, with a twenty-one second Short about a couch and GTA. Over thirty-four million views, from a channel of about one hundred and thirteen thousand subscribers.

And now, the world podium. Bronze medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY”. Over two hours of GTA 6 gameplay, and over thirty-six million views. The king of Asia, on the world podium. And we'll hear from him again.

Silver medal, from the United States, Marvel Entertainment, with the final trailer of Avengers: Doomsday, in theaters December eighteenth. Over fifty million views. Fifty million. And still not number one.

Drum roll, please. The most viewed video of the week on the planet, from the United States: MrBeast Gaming, with “I Survived 100 Hours In GTA 6”. Over seventy-two million views. The game everyone is talking about, on top of the world.

Second list: the conversation. The ten most commented videos in the world. At number ten, from Kenya, Bahati Kenya, with “ZOZA” by Morgan Bahati. Over eight thousand, six hundred comments. Africa's champion of comments and likes makes it to the global list.

Number nine, from the United Kingdom, IAmBeanz, with “GTA 6 Feels Like Something's Off...”. Over nine thousand, nine hundred comments, from a channel of about five thousand subscribers. Five thousand subscribers, world ranking.
Number eight, from France, Ninjaxx, with “La fin du duo”. Over thirteen thousand, four hundred comments.
Number seven, from India, Shivang Mini, with a Roblox Steal an Egg video. Over fourteen thousand, four hundred comments.
Number six, HYPNOS CR, with a GTA 6 video over thirty minutes long. Over sixteen thousand comments, from about one hundred and thirty-two thousand views. Europe's most talked-about video.
Number five, from Japan, なにわ男子, with their official music video. Over twenty thousand, four hundred comments.
Number four, from the United States, Asmongold TV, with “The GTA 6 backlash is getting out of hand”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments.
World podium. Bronze medal, from the United States, skibidi, with “skibidi toilet 83 (part 2)”. Over forty-one thousand comments.
Silver medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY”. Over fifty-four thousand comments. Bronze in views, silver in comments. But someone talked even louder.

And here it is. The most commented video of the week on the planet, from the United States: Marvel Entertainment, with the final trailer of Avengers: Doomsday. Over ninety-two thousand comments. The whole world had something to say.

And the last list: the love. The ten most liked videos in the world. At number ten, Bloxy Productions, with “Why You Exist.”. Over one hundred and seventy-seven thousand likes. The most liked video in Oceania, now in the global ranking.
Number nine, from the United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2, with the misfiring Bugatti Chiron. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes.

Number eight, from India, resham info, explaining how the Kolkata underwater metro was built. Over two hundred and sixty-seven thousand likes, from a channel of about forty-seven thousand subscribers.
Number seven, PORTIA AI STORY LITH. Over two hundred and ninety-eight thousand likes.
Number six, from Turkey, Mr Spring. Over three hundred and three thousand likes. Second list in the world ranking.
Number five, from India, Aman Sharma, with “How Maharashtra Brought a Dead River Back to Life!”. Over three hundred and thirteen thousand likes.
Number four, from the United States, MrBeast, with “Can I Beat Magnus Carlsen?”. Thirty-nine seconds, and over six hundred and thirty-three thousand likes.
The final world podium. Bronze medal, from the United States, MrBeast Gaming, our number one in views. Over seven hundred and seventy-four thousand likes.
Silver medal, from India, Techno Gamerz. Over one million likes. One million, and still not first. Can you guess who is?

Drum roll, please. The most liked video of the week on the planet, from the United States: Marvel Entertainment, with the final trailer of Avengers: Doomsday. Over one million, five hundred thousand likes. Silver in views, gold in comments, gold in likes. The world has spoken.

And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
